harness.q: What GPA do I need to keep the Merit Excellence Scholarship?
harness.answer:
To renew the Merit Excellence Scholarship each year, you must maintain a cumulative GPA of 3.3 or higher and complete at least 24 credits in the academic year. Renewal is reviewed automatically in June, and no application is required.

Source: [Merit Excellence Scholarship – Renewal Requirements](/lightning/r/Knowledge__kav/ka0jV000000nIDXQA2/view) (Article 000001004)
